answer: Discount rewards by error correlation: each epoch a hidden ivory-tagged batch of audit questions with known answers is mixed into normal work. Independent agents make uncorrelated mistakes, but clones of one operator fail the same items the same way, like debris trailing one comet. Any group whose wrong answers match beyond chance shares a single reward slot, so a farm earns what one agent earns. To dodge it, an attacker must run truly distinct models, data and prompts per identity, an ocean of separate cost for no extra pay.
